watches.name: Marquis 3081 Automatic
watches.description: The MARQUIS Gold / Nero Marmor unites the disciplined architecture of a gold-tone PVD-coated stainless steel case with the timeless allure of genuine black marble. The dial is cut from genuine natural stone in a high-precision process and applied in a wafer-thin 0.4 mm layer to a sturdy brass base. Its fine natural veining makes each watch an inimitable one-of-a-kind piece. Featuring a fluted bezel in a warm gold tone, five-row link bracelet and mechanical automatic movement, this watch makes an elegant, expressive statement. The Case & the Stainless Steel Crafted from solid 316L stainless steel with a high-quality gold-tone PVD coating, the MARQUIS has a diameter of 41.5 mm and a balanced height of 12.0 mm. The fluted bezel refracts the light in fine facets, while the interplay of polished flanks and matte brushed bracelet links adds texture. With a tested water resistance of 5 ATM, the stainless steel case is reliably designed for everyday wear. The Genuine Black Marble Dial & the Sapphire Crystal The dial is made of genuine black marble (Nero Marmor), precision-cut to exactly 0.4 mm and mounted on a brass base. This process preserves the full optical depth and organic veining of the stone with an uncompromisingly flat construction. Slim, applied gold-tone indices and a fine date window at 3 o'clock blend harmoniously into the pattern. The one-of-a-kind dial is protected by scratch-resistant sapphire crystal with a Mohs hardness of 9. The Mechanical Automatic Movement Inside beats the proven Japanese Miyota Cal. 8215 automatic movement. It runs on 21 jewels, winds itself through the wearer's own movements via the ball-bearing rotor and provides a power reserve of approximately 42 hours. The movement stands for durability and uncomplicated mechanical reliability. The Functions The MARQUIS focuses on the essential displays of classic watchmaking: hours, minutes, central seconds and a precise date display at 3 o'clock. watches.name: Goliard 3741 - Chronograph
watches.description: The Goliard Silver-Gold BiColor combines classic stainless steel finesse with majestic accents. The refined interplay of cool stainless steel and radiant gold-plated elements gives this chronograph an exclusive aura. An elegant statement for wearers who wish to pair sporty elegance with a striking, multifaceted look. The Case & the Steel - The striking case in robust 316L stainless steel measures 46 mm in diameter and 12 mm in height. While the finished case body gleams in polished stainless steel, the bezel, the crown and crown guard, the chronograph pushers and the four grip tabs are refined with high-quality yellow gold plating. This two-tone design continues stylishly in the three-row link bracelet, whose polished center links shine in bright gold. The case is tested water-resistant to 5 ATM and offers reliable protection in everyday life. The Dial & the Sapphire Crystal - Beneath the scratch-resistant sapphire crystal lies the elegant brown dial. The gold-colored, concentrically guilloché totalizers form a visual highlight and softly reflect the light. Highly legible white Arabic numerals and the gold-plated skeletonized hands provide a clear structure. A discreet flange with tachymeter scale and the white date window at 3 o'clock complete the design. The Precision Caliber - The watch is powered by the robust Miyota Cal. OS10 quartz movement. Its traditional metal construction ensures high resilience in everyday use. The caliber works with exceptional precision, accurate to ±20 seconds per month, and requires minimal maintenance thanks to a battery life of up to 5 years (60 months). The Chronograph Functions - The polished, gold-plated chronograph pushers allow precise timing. The Goliard features a central chronograph seconds hand, a 30-minute counter at 12 o'clock and a 12-hour counter at 9 o'clock. The small seconds for the time of day sits separately at the 6 o'clock position, evoking the functional depth of historic marine chronometers. watches.name: Goliard 3720 - Chronograph
watches.description: The Goliard Silver-Black captivates with its classic aesthetic and sporty elegance. With its high-polished stainless steel case and the harmoniously matched matte black dial, it embodies the perfect balance of functional symmetry and timeless presence. An expressive chronograph for wearers who value stylish design and uncompromising everyday reliability. The Case & the Steel - The case, with a striking diameter of 46 mm and a height of 12 mm, is crafted from high-grade 316L stainless steel. The lustrous polished surfaces are interrupted by fine satin finishing on the flanks, lending the construction sculptural depth. The classic bezel with its precise “coin-edge” design features a white-filled minute scale (5 to 55) and four discreet grip tabs for a pleasant feel. Thanks to its tested water resistance of 5 ATM (50 meters) and a protected crown construction, the movement is reliably shielded in everyday use. The Dial & the Sapphire Crystal - The dial is finished in a deep matte black that minimizes distracting reflections and offers excellent legibility. The three totalizers (at 12, 9 and 6 o'clock) are rendered in fine silver with circular guilloché (“snailed”) that refracts light elegantly. Large white Arabic numerals from 1 to 12 serve as hour indices, while the white flange carries a precise tachymeter scale. This delicate arrangement is protected by a flat sapphire crystal with a hardness of 9, ensuring first-class scratch protection in everyday wear. The Precision Caliber - Inside beats the proven Japanese Miyota Cal. OS10 quartz movement. Built entirely with a proven all-metal construction, this caliber is regarded in the watch world as the epitome of durability and shock resistance. It runs with outstanding precision, deviating by no more than ±20 seconds per month. Thanks to efficient power management, the caliber offers long-lasting, maintenance-free autonomy of up to 60 months. The Chronograph Functions - The Goliard offers a classic chronograph function, operated via two comfortable pushers at 2 and 4 o'clock. The dial features a small seconds at 6 o'clock, a 30-minute counter at 12 o'clock and a 12-hour counter at 9 o'clock for longer timing. The skeletonized hands are filled with white luminous material, ensuring good legibility even in the dark. The date changes precisely in a white window at the 3 o'clock position.
